import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
M = "docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation"
ENV = {**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
v1_raw = Path(M, "fleet.json").read_bytes()
v1 = json.loads(v1_raw)
assert v1["schema_version"] == 1, "run at a commit whose mission fleet is still v1"
assert Path("tests/fixtures/fleet/v1-2a-foundation.json").read_bytes() == v1_raw, "fixture is not a byte copy of the v1 fleet"
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="t062-oracle-"))
try:
    w = tmp / "repo"
    shutil.copytree(".", w, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".git", ".tasks", "__pycache__"))
    def run(*argv, ok=True):
        p = subprocess.run(list(map(str, argv)), cwd=w, env=ENV, text=True, capture_output=True)
        assert (p.returncode == 0) == ok, (argv[:4], p.returncode, p.stdout[-600:], p.stderr[-600:])
        return p
    sys.path.insert(0, str(w / "scripts"))
    import fleet_state as F
    now = "2026-10-16T18:00:00Z"
    models = {"claude": ["opus", "sonnet", "haiku", "fable"],
              "codex": ["gpt-6.1-sol", "gpt-6-sol", "gpt-6-luna", "gpt-5.6-sol", "gpt-5.6-terra", "gpt-5.6-luna"],
              "agent": ["composer-2.5", "composer-2.5-fast", "grok-4.7-low", "grok-4.7-high", "grok-4.7-high-fast", "grok-4.7-xhigh", "cursor-grok-4.6-high"],
              "agy": ["gemini-3.8-flash-high", "gemini-3.8-flash-medium", "gemini-3.8-flash-low", "claude-opus-5-5-low", "claude-opus-5-5-medium",
                      "claude-opus-5-5-high", "gemini-4-argon-low", "gemini-4-argon-medium", "gemini-4-argon-high"]}
    def write_inventory(extra=None):
        providers = {}
        for key in F.PROVIDERS:
            base = {"probed_at": now, "capabilities": F.CAPABILITIES[key], "status": "success", "path": "/bin/" + key}
            names = models[key] + (extra or {}).get(key, [])
            providers[key] = {**base, "aliases": names, "observed_models": []} if key == "claude" else {**base, "aliases": [], "observed_models": names}
        doc = {"schema_version": 1, "probed_at": now, "providers": providers, "last_good": {}, "seats": F.make_seats(providers, {})}
        F.validate_inventory(doc)
        (w / ".tasks").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (w / ".tasks/fleet-inventory.json").write_text(F.canonical(doc))
    write_inventory()
    # The planned migration through the real freeze-v2 entry point.
    bindings = {"brain": ["opus", "high", ["agy", "claude"], "unknown"], "agy.economy": ["flash", "medium", ["agy"], "unknown"],
                "agy.premium": ["argon", "high", ["agy-argon"], "unknown"], "claude.economy": ["haiku", "medium", ["claude"], "unknown"],
                "claude.premium": ["sonnet", "medium", ["claude"], "unknown"], "codex.economy": ["luna", "medium", ["codex"], "unknown"],
                "codex.premium": ["terra", "medium", ["codex"], "unknown"], "cursor.economy": ["composer", "medium", ["cursor-composer"], "standard"],
                "cursor.premium": ["grok", "high", ["cursor-grok"], "standard"]}
    (tmp / "b.json").write_text(json.dumps({n: dict(zip(("family", "effort", "doors", "speed"), b)) for n, b in bindings.items()}))
    (tmp / "p.json").write_text(json.dumps({"billing_classes": ["included"], "fast": False, "no_zdr": "forbid"}))
    (w / M / "fleet.json").unlink()
    run("python3", "scripts/fleet_state.py", "freeze-v2", "--mission-dir", M, "--inventory", ".tasks/fleet-inventory.json", "--bindings", tmp / "b.json",
        "--policy", tmp / "p.json", "--approved-by", "oracle", "--approved-at", now)
    v2 = json.loads((w / M / "fleet.json").read_text())
    want = {n: {k: s[k] for k in ("provider", "model", "effort", "speed")} for n, s in v1["seats"].items()}
    for n in want:
        want[n]["provider"] = {"agent": "cursor"}.get(want[n]["provider"], want[n]["provider"])
    want["brain"] = {"provider": "agy", "model": "claude-opus-5-5-high", "effort": "high", "speed": "unknown"}
    assert {n: s["approved_resolution"] for n, s in v2["seats"].items()} == want, "approved_resolution differs from the plan"
    # 1. A prior drift row naming cursor by its persisted name is not drift; a real change still is.
    log = w / ".tasks/drift/20261014-2a-foundation.jsonl"
    log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    def rows_after(seat, prior):
        log.write_text(json.dumps({"at": now, "mission": M, "seat": seat, "from": prior, "to": prior, "inventory_sha256": "0" * 64}) + "\n")
        run("python3", "scripts/fleet_state.py", "resolve", "--fleet", M + "/fleet.json", "--seat", seat, "--mission-path", M,
            "--inventory", ".tasks/fleet-inventory.json", "--root", w)
        return len(log.read_text().splitlines()) - 1
    grok = {"effort": "high", "model": "grok-4.7-high", "provider": "agent", "speed": "standard"}
    assert rows_after("cursor.premium", grok) == 0, "agent -> cursor written as drift"
    assert rows_after("cursor.premium", {**grok, "model": "grok-4.7-xhigh"}) == 1, "model change not logged"
    assert rows_after("cursor.premium", {**grok, "provider": "codex"}) == 1, "provider change not logged"
    assert rows_after("brain", want["brain"]) == 0
    assert rows_after("brain", {"effort": "high", "model": "opus", "provider": "claude", "speed": "unknown"}) == 1
    # 2. probe-seat reads a v2 seat as dispatch resolves it.
    for n, r in want.items():
        plan = json.loads(run("bash", "scripts/probe-seat.sh", n, "--fleet", M + "/fleet.json", "--dry-run").stdout)
        argv = plan["argv"]
        assert argv[0] == {"cursor": "cursor-agent"}.get(r["provider"], r["provider"]) and r["model"] in argv, (n, argv)
    write_inventory({"codex": ["gpt-7-luna"]})
    argv = json.loads(run("bash", "scripts/probe-seat.sh", "codex.economy", "--fleet", M + "/fleet.json", "--dry-run").stdout)["argv"]
    assert "gpt-7-luna" in argv, ("probe must follow the inventory like dispatch", argv)
    write_inventory()
    # 3. The seat smoke plans v2 seats and gives its clone the inventory that spawn-worker resolves against.
    for args in (("init", "-q"), ("add", "-A"), ("-c", "user.name=o", "-c", "user.email=o@invalid", "commit", "-qm", "v2")):
        run("git", *args)
    plan = json.loads(run("bash", "scripts/fleet-doctor.sh", "--smoke", "--dry-run", "--mission", M, "--dest", tmp / "dest", "--keep").stdout)
    assert sorted(plan["seats"]) == sorted(n for n in want if n != "brain") and sorted(plan["skipped"]) == ["brain"], plan
    argv = plan["seats"]["cursor.premium"]["argv"]
    assert (argv[2], argv[argv.index("--effort") + 1], argv[argv.index("--speed") + 1]) == ("cursor", "high", "standard"), argv
    clone = Path(plan["clone"])
    assert (clone / ".tasks/fleet-inventory.json").read_bytes() == (w / ".tasks/fleet-inventory.json").read_bytes(), "clone lacks the inventory"
    # 4. The suites that used the live fleet as their v1 fixture stay green after the migration.
    for test in ("tests/test-fleet-v2.py", "tests/test-seat-smoke.py", "tests/test-probe-seat.py"):
        run("python3", test)
    print("ok")
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
